chrome.help: Hover an element to see what it does

children.name: StatusToggle
children.help: Your own declaration that this translation is finished. Players see it on the listing, and it is what separates a translation you can play with from one still being written.

children.name: AcceptBranchesToggle
children.text: Let others contribute to this translation
children.help: A contribution is a copy of your work with someone else's changes, sent to you to accept or not. Leave this off to work alone — others can still publish their own version of it.

children.name: NotesInput
children.placeholder: Add any notes about this translation...
children.help: Shown to other players on the website next to your translation

children.name: ResourcesUrlInput
children.help: Optional public link to the fonts and images pack players need for text to render correctly. Shown to anyone who downloads this translation.

children.name: UrlHint
children.text: External link to custom fonts or replacement images. Not hosted by us.

footer.name: UploadBtn
footer.help: Publish this translation online so others can find and download it for this game
